title: Templates
subtitle: Select a template to apply to your businesses
emptyRestaurants: You don't have any businesses yet. Create one under Businesses and assign a template here.
emptyFilters: No templates match this filter combination. Try "All" for one of the criteria.

alert.appliedMessage: Go to template settings to adjust colors and options.

configure.title: Template settings
configure.noOptions: This template has no configuration options defined yet. They will be added per template.

primaryColor.label: Primary color
primaryColor.description: Main template color (buttons, titles, highlighted elements).

showCoverImage.label: Show cover image
showCoverImage.description: If disabled, the cover image is not shown in the template.

showLogo.label: Show logo
showLogo.description: If disabled, the business logo is not shown.

showRestaurantName.label: Show business name
showRestaurantName.description: If disabled, the business name is not shown.

showRestaurantDescription.label: Show business description
showRestaurantDescription.description: If disabled, the business description is not shown.

restaurantNameColor.label: Business name color
restaurantNameColor.description: Text color for the business name in the header.

sectionTitleFontSize.label: Section title font size
sectionTitleFontSize.description: Text size for menu category titles (for example: Burgers, Sides).

showTranslationFlags.label: Show translation flags
showTranslationFlags.description: If disabled, flag icons are hidden in the public menu language switcher when multiple translations are available.

fontFamily.label: Typography
fontFamily.description: Font for template titles and body text.

showProductImages.label: Show product photos
showProductImages.description: Show the product photo when available (no placeholder if missing).

backgroundImageUrl.label: Background image
backgroundImageUrl.description: Full-screen background photo. Each business can have its own.

colorMode.label: Color mode
colorMode.description: Base look of the menu when automatic day/night switching is off.

autoDayNightSwitch.label: Switch by day/night schedule
autoDayNightSwitch.description: Toggles light and dark mode based on the timezone and configured hours.

templateTimezone.label: Timezone
templateTimezone.description: Timezone used to decide day or night. If unset, the business timezone is used.

dayStartHour.label: Day start hour
dayStartHour.description: Local hour from which it is considered day (light mode). Value from 0 to 23.

dayEndHour.label: Day end hour
dayEndHour.description: Local hour from which night begins (dark mode). Value from 0 to 23.

dayLogoUrl.label: Logo (light mode)
dayLogoUrl.description: Logo for light mode. If unset, the business logo is used.

nightLogoUrl.label: Logo (dark mode)
nightLogoUrl.description: Logo for dark mode. If unset, the day logo or business logo is used.

dayCoverImageUrl.label: Day cover
dayCoverImageUrl.description: Cover image for light mode. Takes priority over the business cover.

nightCoverImageUrl.label: Night cover
nightCoverImageUrl.description: Cover image for dark mode. Takes priority over the business cover.
